passages.note: Bill status page shows Hoffman as Prime sponsor of HB2492, signed by the Governor 03/30/2022; his own act as sponsor, from his Arizona House years.

passages.provision_quote: Except for a form produced by the United States election assistance commission, any application for registration shall be accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship as prescribed in section 16-166, subsection F, and the county recorder or other officer in charge of elections shall reject any application for registration that is not accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship.
passages.note: Enacted bill text requires documentary proof of citizenship to register, matching rung 5's clause exactly and excluding the polling-place/mail-ballot ID clauses of rungs 1-4.
House Third Reading final-passage vote lists 'HOFFMAN Y' on a contested 31-26-3-0-0 tally, so it is not near-unanimous and counts as his own act.

rows.reasoning: Hoffman was Prime sponsor of HB2492 (2022) and voted Y on its House Third Reading passage (31-26-3-0-0); the enacted text requires that registration applications 'be accompanied by satisfactory evidence of citizenship' and be rejected without it, matching rung 5, 'Require documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote.' Under the V5 ruling on earlier-chamber records, his 2022 House sponsorship and vote count as in-term for his current Senate seat.
